payout_quote: Earn up to $550 for your first 6 plasma donations when you become a new donor. Sign up and earn a $55 bonus after your second donation. Must be 18 or older and able to complete the donation to participate. Amount of compensation depends on number of donations. Must be a new donor to claim $55 bonus after 2nd donation. Terms and conditions apply.
steps: Find a KEDPlasma center on the official site and sign up as a new donor.
Attend your first visit (about 2 hours): pre-screening physical exam, blood sample for communicable-disease and protein checks, and medical history questions.
Complete your first 6 plasma donations to earn up to the $550 new-donor total; the $55 bonus is paid after your second donation.
Receive compensation for your time and effort after each donation (compensation amount depends on number of donations).
catches: $550 is an 'up to' ceiling for the first 6 donations and the page states 'amount of compensation depends on number of donations' — your actual total depends on center rates.
Must be 18 or older, a new donor, and able to complete the donation; you must pass the pre-screening physical exam, blood sample checks, and medical history questions — not everyone qualifies.
Each donation visit takes roughly 90-150 minutes of your time; you must donate repeatedly (twice weekly for new-donor offers) to earn the headline totals.
First visit takes about 2 hours; subsequent visits take just over an hour — 6 donations is a real time commitment.
Specific rates vary by center; KEDPlasma does not publish a full per-donation pay chart online.
biggest_catch: The $550 is an 'up to' ceiling and 'amount of compensation depends on number of donations' — actual per-donation rates vary by center and are not published online; you must pass the pre-screening physical exam and blood checks.
eligibility: 18+, new donor, able to complete the donation; must pass pre-screening physical exam, blood sample checks (communicable diseases, protein levels), and medical history questions.
timing: The $55 bonus is paid after your second donation; regular compensation is paid after each completed donation.
